title: Retry cleanup after a Windows process lets go of a landed lane
trigger: Merge closes the item, but Windows keeps the lane folder because a shell stands in it or another program holds a file in it (WinError 5 or 32) for longer than the 2-second retry.
need: Read the merge warning "merged; lane cleanup deferred: <path> in use by another program": the item is closed and only cleanup waits. Close programs holding the folder or move their working directories out of the lane. The relay's lane sweep, every 15 minutes, then retires the lane; to finish now, rerun the yoke merge item command named in the warning from the main checkout.
